items.title: Call for Papers: Vol. 2, No. 2 — AGI and Its Societal Impact
items.summary: AI & Future Society is now accepting submissions for Vol. 2, No. 2, a regular issue focused on the societal impact of AGI. As with previous issues, no article processing charges will be collected. Publication is planned for early to mid-November.

items.title: Call for Papers: Vol. 2, No. 1 (May 2026) | No APC This Issue
items.summary: Now accepting submissions for AI & Future Society Vol. 2, No. 1 (May 2026). Submission deadline: April 15, 2026. No APC. Regular issue with an editorial theme on AI, algorithmic thresholds, and social fairness.

items.title: Call for Papers – November 2025 Issue of AI & Future Society
items.summary: Submissions are now open for the November 2025 issue. We especially welcome original research exploring the societal, ethical, and governance dimensions of artificial intelligence.
